smell: `valueSchema` emits `S.optionalKey(...)` for generated element-specific attributes (boolean, enum, numeric, and string attributes), so the generated decoded HTML AST represents absence as `undefined` instead of `Option`.
proposedTarget: Change the generator to emit `S.OptionFromOptionalKey(<attr schema>).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` for decoded attribute absence while keeping the encoded key optional; add the generated `SchemaUtils` import. In-repo target shape is verified by `packages/foundation/modeling/schema/test/SchemaUtils.test.ts:123` and `packages/foundation/modeling/lexical/src/Lexical.model.ts:687-688`. This is a public-form change, so it needs the same-PR generated-output and consumer sweep required by SPEC §5.4.

smell: Hand-authored WHATWG global attributes use `S.optionalKey(...)` for every optional decoded attribute (`accesskey`, `autocapitalize`, `autofocus`, etc.), mirroring encoded absence as TypeScript `undefined` in the domain type.
proposedTarget: Introduce local Optional* helpers that use `S.OptionFromOptionalKey(schema).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` and apply them to the hand-authored global attribute bundle. Use the same target shape as `SchemaUtils.test.ts:123` and the Lexical `$` field at `Lexical.model.ts:687-688`; keep the encoded form optional, and handle the public `GlobalAttributesType` ripple in the same PR.
